release_notes: Analytics entity filters, finished properly: Trends and Cohort views get multi-select filters by campaigns, offers and landings (dropdown groups, in-dropdown search, select all / clear, active-filter badges). The earlier attempt showed nothing because the built frontend bundle was never committed — dist/index.js predates the feature commits, so the panel kept serving the old build; dist is rebuilt and committed now. Also fixed in this release: the Cohort view silently ignored the new filters because its fetch effect did not re-run on selection changes; entity dropdowns now use the lightweight campaigns_simple / offers_simple endpoints (both expose group_id for grouping) instead of the heavy report lists; the trends and cohort filter whitelists accept landing_id with parameterized IN queries; the dropdown's 'No results' string is translated in all 7 languages. AFTER UPDATING, HARD-RELOAD THE PANEL ONCE (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R) — index.js has a stable filename and browsers cache the old build.
